Name: Everybody is Pam
Author: thefatpotato115
Description:
As I said before, This mod changes (almost) all of the NPCs into pam. Characters will still have the same schedule, dialogue, and portraits (to help you distinguish.)

[size=3]More features:[/size]
[list]
[*]Makes the Beer and the TV remote (this is only really useful if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url].)﻿ items universal loves
[*]Turns the Shadow Archer into Pam so you can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3201]Spawn Monsters mod[/url] to summon Pam (It will throw beer at you)
[*]Turns hairstyle 41 into Pam so you can look like her.﻿
[*]Changes all three dogs into Pam
[*]Changes the title screen to say Pam Valley
[*]Puts Pam in your window
[/list]

Combine it with
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3887]Pam as a horse
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11784]Pam Bus
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11865]Pam Trailer
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1849]Pam in shipping bin[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18694]Pam in shipping bin2[/url]
and you'll have the entire village looking like Pam!

Disclaimer: I use the game in English and some features may not work for other languages.

If something doesn't work for you, or you want a new feature to be added, [b]please let me know![/b] I'm always trying to improve this mod and would appreciate the help.
